name: Buffalo-Style White Bean Quesadilla with Blue Cheese & Tossed Salad
instructions: Drain and rinse beans in a colander. Transfer to a medium bowl and pat dry with paper towels. Add cheese, hot sauce, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the filling.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, lay tortillas on a flat surface and divide bean filling between them, arranging on one half of each tortilla. Fold tortillas in half to close. (Reserve bowl for the salad.)

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, place assembled quesadillas in the skillet and cook, flipping halfway through, until golden on both sides, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate.

Meanwhile, wash, dry and chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Wipe the reserved bowl clean with paper towels (if desired); place lettuce, carrots, and vinaigrette in the bowl, then toss to combine the salad.
Cut each quesadilla into wedges and divide between plates; serve with salad on the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
